title: 電気法規と電気施設管理
subtitle: Laws Regulations and Management for Electrical Facilities
keywords: Electrical Appliances and Materials Safety Act
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn about various regulations for electric power companies. (2) learn the regulations to ensure the safety of electrical appliances and materials. (3) learn the license and duties of electricians. (4) learn the standards of electrical equipment. (5) learn about the construction, maintenance and operation of electrical facilities.
advice:
This course will cover the following materials:

1. Electrical laws and regulations
 1.1 Electricity business act
 1.2 Electrical appliances and materials safety act
 1.3 Electricians act
 1.4 Guide book of electrical equipment
2. Management for electrical facilities

Students are required to actively participate in class.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of electric power and energy.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the electrical laws and regulations.
Be able to understand the guide book of electrical equipment and explain the technical standards.
Be able to explain the construction, maintenance, and operation of electrical facilities.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Fully understand the electrical laws and regulations and explain them.
(2) Fully understand the basic terms in the guide book of electrical equipment and explain the technical standards.
(3) Fully understand the construction, maintenance, and operation of electrical facilities.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the electrical laws and regulations and outline them.
(2) Understand the basic terms in the guide book of electrical equipment and explain some of the technical standards.
(3) Understand the construction, maintenance, and operation of electrical facilities.
